While libraries like PyTorch and frameworks like Ember are mentioned as tools that have defined their space, the sources also highlight that new frameworks, languages, and libraries may struggle to gain traction in the AI coding era due to the bias towards mature technologies that have more resources and community support. React, though technically a library, is noted for its significant role in web and mobile application development. The sources emphasize the importance of understanding the fundamental concepts and evaluating the adoption and issues of new tools before integrating them into projects.
